prompt: In a watercolor illustration, a rooftop party unfolds under the night sky. On the left, a woman in a blue dress stands holding a champagne flute. Next to her on the right, a man in a green suit points toward the distant city lights. In the center, a golden retriever sits calmly on a wooden crate, watching the scene with gentle eyes. Behind the dog, a child in a yellow raincoat leans against a railing, looking at the stars above. To the far right, an elderly person in a grey coat hands a small gift box to the woman in the blue dress. There is no moon visible in the dark sky. The soft washes of color blend the figures into the urban backdrop, capturing the quiet energy of the gathering without sharp lines or harsh contrasts. The composition balances the five distinct entities across the frame, emphasizing their simple poses and connections through subtle gestures and shared space on the elevated terrace.
